candidates.sentence: Celeste will fight to secure our border, finish the wall, fully fund our border patrol, and keep dangerous drugs like fentanyl out of our communities.
Celeste will get inflation under control by reining in our out of control federal spending and regulations that are driving up our cost of living.
She will fight for balanced budgets to stop the out of control reckless spending in Washington.
Celeste believes all human life is sacred and will stand up for the unborn and our pro-life values in Congress.
